decision: approve merge; exact equivalence preserved and moving-100 target met

nodeComparison.fixture: unchanged observation-benchmark-fixture.cjs; stationary/moving 50/100 units; sequential fresh processes with alternating order; both cores receive the same parsed map and dependencies
nodeComparison.notes: Median and p95 summaries are medians of per-process statistics; maximum is the largest observed step. State JSON and existing counters compare byte-for-byte. Diagnostics run after the timed fixture and are excluded from timings. Heap values follow forced GC but remain process-level observations, not allocation counts or device guarantees.

browserComparison.notes: Actual headless Chromium using the exact WIP11D and WIP11E standalone HTML over local HTTP. Independent simulation scenarios run while the app scenario is paused. CPU fixed-step time, not render FPS or a physical-device result.

sceneComparison.notes: Supplementary fixed placements; 500 warmup exposures, then seven rounds of 2,000 uncached nine-ray exposures per fresh process. Baseline/current process order alternates. CPU time, not simulation step or FPS.

sceneRepeatProtocol: Initial 3-process scene results showed two tail regressions; repeated with 5 alternating fresh processes. Only the reviewer parent trial count and report trials field were changed in memory; checked-in script and per-worker scene/warmup/round/workload settings were unchanged.
limits: CPU measurements are not whole-game FPS or physical-device guarantees.

Reviewer stationary-100 median was 0.86% slower; its p95 improved.
Some individual maxima increased; aggregate p95 and median improvements are not worst-case latency guarantees.
file:// remained blocked by Chromium policy; the same standalone HTML was tested over local HTTP.
